# langsmith_feedback_config (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a LangSmith feedback score configuration by its feedback key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "langsmith_feedback_config" "example" {
  feedback_key = "correctness"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `feedback_key` (String) The feedback key name to look up.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this data source.

### Read-Only

- `categories` (String) JSON array of category objects for categorical type.
- `feedback_type` (String) The feedback type: `continuous` or `categorical`.
- `id` (String) The identifier (same as `feedback_key`).
- `is_lower_score_better` (Boolean) Whether a lower score is better.
- `max` (Number) Maximum score value (for continuous type).
- `min` (Number) Minimum score value (for continuous type).
- `modified_at` (String) When the feedback config was last modified.
